$comment: Parity gate for the cJSON C-to-Rust port. c_cmd runs tools/cjson-oracle.c compiled against the unmodified cJSON.c; rust_cmd runs tools/rust-driver over cjson-core. Both print the report described in tools/DRIVER_FORMAT.md. `make parity` additionally runs the same oracle source linked against the Rust cjson-ffi library.
